resources.string: The Close button minimises to the tray
Notio stays in the tray and reminders keep ringing; Exit in the menu of the tray icon (right click) ends it.
Notio is still running in the tray. Right-click its icon and choose Exit to end it.
Do not start a second Notio
Starting Notio again brings the open window to the front. Takes effect at the next start.
Without it the recording is stopped in the note or from the menu of the tray icon (right click).
Notio starts in the background when you sign in to Windows, so reminders ring from the start.
Available in the installed or portable Notio.
Works after Notio is started again. Automatic draws without the graphics card on a virtual or basic display adapter, where the card makes the window stutter. Now: %1$s. Display adapters: %2$s.
Notio cannot start: files of the program are missing or damaged. Install Notio again. Your notes and settings stay in place.
Notio is already running but does not answer. End Notio in the Task Manager and start it again.
